name: Goi buoi da xanh
summary: A salad of green-skin pomelo, served with the fish and the hotpot on the Thới Sơn orchard table.
howToEat: Order it with the other islet plates at the midday orchard stop.
where: The orchard stops on cù lao Thới Sơn, about 6 km from Mỹ Tho by boat.
seoTitle: Goi buoi da xanh on Thoi Son
seoDescription: Gỏi bưởi da xanh, the green-skin pomelo salad on the Thới Sơn orchard table.
